title: Marble Maze Tilt with Undo/Redo
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with a 3D marble maze game using Three.js with tilt controls and an undo/redo system.

## Scene Setup
- Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 12, 8) looking down at the maze.
- Add ambient light (intensity 0.4) and a directional light at (5, 10, 5) with intensity 0.8, casting shadows.
- Set the renderer background to #1a1a2e.

## Maze Board
- Create a flat rectangular board (12 x 12 x 0.3) using MeshStandardMaterial with color #4a6741.
- The board can tilt on X and Z axes. Maximum tilt angle is 0.15 radians in any direction.
- Add raised walls (height 0.5, thickness 0.2) on the board to form a maze pattern. Use at least 8 wall segments creating corridors. Walls should be color #8B4513.
- Add 3 holes (cylinders with dark material, radius 0.4) at various positions on the board that act as traps. If the marble falls in, it resets to start.
- Place a goal zone (a glowing green circle, radius 0.5) at the far corner of the maze.

## Marble
- Create a sphere (radius 0.3) with MeshStandardMaterial, color #e74c3c, metalness 0.7, roughness 0.3.
- The marble starts at position (-4, 0.5, -4) on the board.
- Simulate simple physics: the marble rolls based on board tilt angle. Apply gravity component along the tilted surface. Use velocity and friction (friction coefficient 0.98). Clamp marble speed to max 0.15 per frame.
- The marble must collide with walls and board edges (bounce with restitution 0.3).

## Animated Box Asset
- Load 'BoxAnimated.glb' using GLTFLoader. Place it at position (4, 0.5, 4) near the goal zone as a decorative trophy/reward object.
- Play its animation using AnimationMixer. Scale it to (0.5, 0.5, 0.5).
- When the marble reaches the goal, make the box jump (translate Y by 2 units over 0.5 seconds and back).

## Controls
- Arrow keys tilt the board: Up/Down tilt around X-axis, Left/Right tilt around Z-axis.
- Each key press changes tilt by 0.03 radians per frame while held.
- When no key is pressed, tilt gradually returns to 0 (multiply by 0.95 each frame).

## Undo/Redo System
- Every 0.5 seconds, record a snapshot: {marblePos: {x,y,z}, marbleVel: {x,y,z}, tiltX, tiltZ, timestamp}.
- Store up to 100 snapshots in a history array.
- Press 'U' key to undo: restore the previous snapshot state. Move the history pointer back.
- Press 'R' key to redo: restore the next snapshot state. Move the history pointer forward.
- Undo/redo should instantly teleport the marble and set the board tilt.

## HUD / UI
- Add a DOM overlay div with id='hud' showing:
  - 'Time: Xs' (elapsed seconds since start) in a span with id='timer'
  - 'Undos: N' in a span with id='undo-count' tracking total undo actions taken
  - 'State: playing|won|reset' in a span with id='game-state'
  - 'History: N/M' in a span with id='history-info' showing current position / total snapshots
- Add two HTML buttons: id='btn-undo' (text 'Undo') and id='btn-redo' (text 'Redo') that work same as U/R keys.
- Add a 'Reset' button with id='btn-reset' that resets marble to start, clears history, resets timer.

## State Management
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with these fields updated every frame:
  - marbleX, marbleY, marbleZ: marble world position (rounded to 3 decimals)
  - marbleVelX, marbleVelZ: marble velocity components
  - tiltX, tiltZ: current board tilt in radians
  - gameState: 'playing' | 'won' | 'reset'
  - elapsedTime: seconds since start (integer)
  - undoCount: total undo actions performed
  - redoCount: total redo actions performed
  - historyLength: number of snapshots stored
  - historyIndex: current position in history
  - marbleSpeed: magnitude of velocity vector
  - goalReached: boolean
  - holesFallen: number of times marble fell in a hole
  - boxAnimPlaying: boolean, whether the BoxAnimated animation is active
  - boardTiltMagnitude: Math.sqrt(tiltX*tiltX + tiltZ*tiltZ)

## Physics Constraints
- Marble must stay within board bounds (-6 to 6 on X and Z).
- Marble Y should hover around 0.3-0.8 above board surface during normal play.
- Velocity should never be NaN.
- Board tilt must stay within [-0.15, 0.15] radians on both axes.
- Friction must slow the marble when board is level.
physics_constraints: Marble rolls under gravity on tilted surface with friction 0.98. Max speed 0.15/frame. Wall collision with restitution 0.3. Board tilt clamped to ±0.15 rad. Marble bounded to board area [-6,6]. No NaN in velocity or position.
